integrity: The proof uses published momentum-space threshold formulas and a published square-lattice potential-kernel asymptotic expansion. Finite checker output is corroborative only and is not treated as a proof of the infinite asymptotic statement.
scientific limitations: Nearest-neighbor square-lattice dispersion only; normalized threshold profiles only; no off-threshold asymptotics or general hopping-matrix extension is claimed. An unindexed equivalent coordinate-space derivation remains a residual originality risk.
title: Dipole–quadrupole spatial tails at two square-lattice threshold states
